test_title: PYST 34: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A person who spends 52% of his monthly income is able to save ₹7,740 per month. His monthly expenses (in) are:
solution:
**Given:**

Savings = ₹7,740

Percentage of income spent = 52%

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenses + Savings

**Calculation:**

Let monthly income = ₹x

Expenses = 52% of x = 0.52x

Savings = 7,740 = 48% of x = 0.48x

⇒ 0.48x = 7,740

⇒ x = 7,740 ÷ 0.48

⇒ x = 16,125

⇒ Expenses = 0.52 × 16,125 = 8,385

**∴ Monthly expenses = ₹8,385**
